trades.name: USO
trades.why: Crude fell 4.5% to its lowest close since August on the market's best day in a year and through a weekend of attacks that should have lifted it: Trump pushed any return to war with Iran to next year, supply is coming back and the glut forecasts are unanswered, with OPEC+ expected to lift 2027 quotas on 11-29.
trades.wrong_if: The US or Israel strikes Iran, or Trump or the White House says the talks have failed or sets a new deadline inside the window; or shipping through Hormuz is reported halted or sharply cut (not just a ship attacked); or the 11-25 EIA report shows a crude draw of 3 million barrels or more; or Reuters or Bloomberg reports OPEC+ delegates preparing to cut or hold back 2027 output at the 11-29 meeting.

trades.name: ANF
trades.why: A quarter that beat on operations this time (comps +6%, margin 15.5%, prices up on lean inventory) with the year raised and November called strong, in a stock at about 12 times earnings whose broker targets now sit at or under the price, with Black Friday inside the window.
trades.wrong_if: Two or more covering brokers downgrade Abercrombie or leave targets under $160 citing refunds or 2027 after the print; or Black Friday and Cyber Monday reads (Adobe, Mastercard SpendingPulse, Sensormatic or the like) show apparel sales or traffic down on the year or name heavy promotions at Abercrombie or Hollister; or Abercrombie trims its Q4 guide, inside the window.

trades.name: DKS
trades.why: The report took away the fear that had cut the stock by a third: Foot Locker comps turned positive, the year was raised, about 18% of the float is short and the company bought 8% of its shares last quarter, at about 13 times earnings.
trades.wrong_if: Two or more covering brokers downgrade Dick's or cut targets under $150 after the print; or Dick's, Nike or a major outlet says Foot Locker's comps have turned negative again this quarter or that the Jordan reset is cutting its allocations before year-end; or Black Friday and Cyber Monday reads show sporting goods or athletic footwear sales down on the year, inside the window.

trades.name: DY
trades.why: The 17% drop is a reset of the story, not a quarter: management said several large customers decided in recent weeks to slow fiber builds, so fiber-to-the-home revenue falls next fiscal year, and the broker resets have barely started.
trades.wrong_if: A large customer (AT&T, Verizon, Lumen or another named carrier) says its 2027 fiber build is unchanged or rising, or Dycom says the slowdown is smaller than it described; or two or more covering brokers upgrade Dycom after the print; or Dycom adds to its buyback or reports insider buying after the report, inside the window.

trades.name: Copper miners
trades.why: Copper gave back all of Monday's Nvidia bounce in one session and is at new lows for the move, down 21% from September's record; the reason the miners are falling is still running and no company event in the window can turn it.
trades.wrong_if: A supply shock is reported (an outage, strike or export halt at a major copper producer) and the metals press credits it with lifting copper; or China announces a stimulus, property or steel-capacity measure that the metals press credits with lifting copper; or CME FedWatch pricing of a 12-9 hike falls below about 80% after the PCE report; or China's regulator approves the Anglo-Teck merger and the group rallies with it.
